sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate Daniel Montalto on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Daniel Montalto to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers in the town of Montgomery
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to employees of the town court of the town of Montgomery serving as uniformed court officers at such town court.

sponsored.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Jason T McGlone
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Hancock to Jason T McGlone.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate John Raftery on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
sponsored.sum: Authorizes John Raftery to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption from certain requirements for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption from certain requirements for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises located in Orange county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the residency of certain officers of the village of Washingtonville, Orange county
sponsored.sum: Expands the residency requirement for the village clerk, deputy village clerk, village treasurer, and deputy village treasurer of the village of Washingtonville such that such person need not be a resident of such village, but must be a resident in the county in which such village is located or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes a community housing fund in the town of Rochester, county of Ulster
sponsored.sum: Establishes a community housing fund in the town of Rochester, county of Ulster, to provide housing opportunities for its residents.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District; deems such school district to have been a participating employer beginning on July 1, 2025 and relates to contributions made by eligible employees on and after July 1, 2025.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Kevin Donohue to take the civil service examination for the position of police officer for the town of Goshen
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Kevin Donohue to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of full-time police officer for the town of Goshen.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property to the town of Goshen
sponsored.sum: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property located on the Mid-Hudson Forensic Psychiatric Center campus to the town of Goshen.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Goshen central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Goshen central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York innovative learning models act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York innovative learning models act to provide grants to eligible entities for the planning, development, implementation, replication and scaling of innovative learning models.

sponsored.t: Directs local social services districts to implement an income eligibility standard when available child care block grant funding is nearing exhaustion
sponsored.sum: Provides that a social services district may implement an income eligibility standard for recipients of child care block grant funds when such district projects that allocated funds will be insufficient to open all eligible non-guaranteed cases; sets the income eligibility standards.

sponsored.t: Establishes term limits for the office of governor and for members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Establishes term limits for the office of governor and for members of the legislature; changes the term for members of the legislature to a four year term.

sponsored.t: Authorizes police officers the ability to request a person who is driving a motor vehicle with tinted windows roll down all windows to protect such officer's health or safety
sponsored.sum: Authorizes police officers the ability to request a person who is driving a motor vehicle with tinted windows roll down all windows to protect such officer's health or safety; defines "tinted windows".

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to promulgate rules requiring the use of automatic license plate reader systems at all entrances and exits to state parks
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to promulgate rules and regulations requiring the use of automatic license plate reader systems at all entrances and exits to state parks and to assist municipalities in establishing policies and procedures for similar use of such license plate readers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the sector partnership enhancement and reinforcement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the sector partnership enhancement and reinforcement program to assist in the identification of target industry clusters and employers for creation of new local sector partnerships and to provide grants to emerging and existing local sector partnerships and to community colleges seeking to establish local sector partnerships for recruitment activities; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Includes the county of Orange within the definition of a designated community
sponsored.sum: Includes the county of Orange within the definition of a designated community for purposes of community preservation funds.

sponsored.t: Establishes a farm savings account program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a farm savings account program.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of local labor to qualify for certain real property tax exemptions relating to business investment and the installation of certain energy systems
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of local labor to qualify for certain real property tax exemptions relating to business investment and the installation of certain energy systems; defines local labor; provides for exceptions from the local labor requirement in certain circumstances where local labor is not qualified to perform the work or available.

sponsored.t: Establishes a certified transitional tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a certified transitional tax credit for taxpayers that demonstrate their agricultural products were sold during a period of transition into USDA organic certification, under the Whole Foods Market IP. L.P. "responsibly grown" labelling program, or under the QAI and Hesco, Inc. "certified transitional" label.

sponsored.t: Allows non-public schools to apply for school zone speed limits
sponsored.sum: Allows non-public schools to apply for school zone speed limits on the road that such school is located on.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to pay employees who are manual workers no less than semi-monthly
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to pay employees who are manual workers no less than semi-monthly; provides that there is no civil penalty against an employer by an employee who unknowingly violates such provisions; authorizes the commissioner to levy a civil penalty against employers who violate such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments of grants to farm operations by NYSERDA
sponsored.sum: Relates to payments of grants to farm operations by NYSERDA; provides that payment of such grants shall be made no later than ninety days after notification.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study to identify, analyze, report, and medically combat new or previously unseen opiate/opioid compounds found in overdose patients in New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study to identify, analyze, report, and medically combat new or previously unseen opiate/opioid compounds found in overdose patients in New York state for the purpose of establishing more efficient overdose medical treatment protocols.

sponsored.t: Relates to sentencing of a person convicted of murdering a child who is less than thirteen years old
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person convicted of murder in the first or second degree, or aggravated murder, in the death of a child who is less than thirteen years old shall be sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.

sponsored.t: Relates to the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the provision of law that volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers who receive a real property tax exemption for service may not receive the income tax credit for such service.

sponsored.t: Relates to certifying certain professionals as emergency service technicians to service rural areas
sponsored.sum: Allows certain certified registered nurse anesthetists, nurse practitioners, physician assistants or physicians to be able to be certified as an emergency service technician to service rural areas of the state.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit to taxpayers who grow the base ingredients necessary for the production of beer
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit to taxpayers who grow the base ingredients necessary for the production of beer.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of children and family services to conduct a study that examines barriers to the creation of child care providers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of children and family services to conduct a study that examines barriers to the creation of child care providers and provide recommendations thereto to facilitate the creation of new child care providers.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance promulgate regulations and create policies to encourage married adults or two adult households when determining the standard of need for eligibility
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance promulgate regulations and create policies to encourage married adults or two adult households when determining the standard of need for eligibility for public assistance programs; and to exempt certain income and resources for such adults and households.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing loan forgiveness for agriculture educators
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing loan forgiveness for agriculture educators who provide didactic instruction to students about agriculture, food, and natural resources.

sponsored.t: Creates a commission to reform public assistance benefits
sponsored.sum: Creates a commission to reform public assistance benefits to conduct a study to examine the current payment method for public assistance benefits and to identify any and all income levels that exist where an individual or family would become ineligible for any public assistance benefit.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of the term 'sex work' and certain variations of such term in the law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of the term "sex work" and certain variations of such term in the law or any rule, regulation or resolution.

sponsored.t: Establishes a supplemental real property tax exemption for veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a supplemental property tax exemption for veterans and certain un-remarried spouses of veterans upon the adoption of a local law, ordinance or resolution.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force on victim services reimbursements
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force on victim services reimbursements to study laws, rules and regulations to modernize funding for victim services providers.

sponsored.t: Requires social media platforms to remove content depicting the violent death of a human being within twenty-fours after receiving notice or otherwise becoming aware of such content
sponsored.sum: Requires social media platforms to remove content depicting the violent death of a human being within twenty-fours after receiving notice or otherwise becoming aware of such content; requires social media platforms to provide an easily accessible and usable mechanism for users to report such content.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Chester to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Chester to impose a five percent hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the membership and purposes of the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Coldenham Inc.
sponsored.sum: Relates to the membership and purposes of the Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association of Coldenham Inc.; changes the name of the association to the "Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Coldenham, Inc"; updates the purposes of such association and the use of taxes received by such association.

sponsored.t: Extends the village of Goshen's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the village of Goshen's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax of up to five percent for an additional two years.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization to impose certain taxes in the county of Sullivan.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Jack Barletta
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Jack Barletta on state route 208 in the county of Orange.

sponsored.t: Relates to community preservation funds for the town of Chester
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Chester to establish community preservation funds; establishes a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in said community preservation fund.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Montgomery to impose a hotel and motel tax; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Montgomery to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Extends the town of Goshen's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the town of Goshen's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax of up to five percent for two additional years.
